title: HaLab Twin
coordinate_convention: Z up. camera_to_world columns: right, up, backward, position; OpenGL -Z forward.
comparison: MuJoCo reference state at the recorded pose and intrinsics; no pose optimization.

walls.source: Original RGB-D and camera poses only
walls.method: Robust vertical plane fitting to confidence-filtered raw depth normals; 7.5 cm inlier band. Wall intersections close the room. Wall top uses the modal high horizontal depth surface; unobserved spans and a level ceiling are extrapolated. Thickness and door heights are estimates.
